posts.title: “But can it run Doom?”
posts.description: Some time ago now, a colleague and I were running a coding workshop for young people, using Pytch. We were talking with the club’s facilitator about Pytch, and he asked the age-old question: But can it run Doom? posts.title: More Dragon 32 nostalgia
posts.description: Continuing the Dragon 32 theme, I extracted from cassette a sequence of versions of a Tetris clone I wrote long ago, and tidied it up a bit.

posts.title: Reverse-engineering the Dragon 32 game Invader’s Revenge
posts.description: Partly for the challenge, and partly for nostalgia, I reverse-engineered the Dragon 32 game Invader's Revenge, creating an essentially complete commented disassembly. I also created a Pytch version, which is embedded in the full write-up.
